questions.q: What did Andjelka manage to buy?
questions.e: In the video: "ali je ovo limited edition" — but this is a limited edition.

questions.q: What does Andrija call her perfume-buying habit?
questions.e: In the video: "Ti imaš bolest kupovanja parfema, Anđelka." — you have a perfume-buying disease, Andjelka.

questions.q: When, according to Andrija, will she stop wasting money?
o: When she starts earning it herself
questions.e: In the video: "Kad počneš da ih zarađuješ, veruj mi." — when you start earning it, believe me.

questions.q: zamisli kako je glupo da nemam to u svojoj *kolekciji*.
*Rasipaš* pare na marketinške trikove, na budalaštine, bre.
Rasipaš pare na marketinške trikove, na *budalaštine*, bre.

questions.e: The subject is in the nominative: parfem.
"A disease of what?" — genitive case: bolest kupovanja.

questions.q: Znaš ti kada ćeš ti da ___ da rasipaš pare, Anđe?
questions.e: After da — the present tense; prestati is perfective ("to stop"), 2nd pers. sg.: prestaneš.
